description: Two channels that invert or scale a signal under manual and voltage control, reaching twice the input level at the extremes

params.text: Sets how much of that channel's CV jack is added to the polarity; at full, 5V of CV gives unity gain and 10V gives twice the input level
Sets that channel's polarity by hand, -2 to +2 — silence in the middle, inversion below it, twice the input level at either extreme. Summed with the CV before it is applied

inputs.text: Controls that channel's polarity, scaled by the CV amount knob and summed with POLARITY. A negative voltage inverts the signal
The signal to be polarized; polyphonic, with every channel polarized by the same amount

outputs.text: Carries that channel's input multiplied by the polarity, clamped to 10V either way

notes: the red and green lamps show the polarity being applied rather than the signal level, red for inversion and green for positive
